2607.06202.title: UBEP: Re-architecting Expert Parallelism Communication Library for Production Superpods
2607.06202.paper_summary: The deployment of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models on production high-bandwidth superpods, such as NVIDIA's NVL72/576 and Huawei's CloudMatrix384, introduces critical challenges beyond raw interconnect bandwidth. While these systems provide unified global address spaces and high-bandwidth fabrics, their full potential for sparse MoE communication is hindered by three fundamental bottlenecks: (1) Strict execution serialization imposed by coarse-grained Bulk Synchronous Parallel (BSP) orchestration of interdependent communication phases; (2) Prohibitive synchronization overhead that fails to scale alongside high interconnect bandwidth; and (3) Severe load imbalance resulting from distance-agnostic scheduling of irregular token traffic. To eliminate these bottlenecks, we introduce UBEP (Unified-Bus Expert Parallelism), a production-ready communication library that rethinks MoE's All-to-All primitives for modern superpod architectures. Through large scale experiments, UBEP reduces All-to-All latency by up to 52.4% and MoE inference Time Per Output Token (TPOT) by up to 11.1%.
2607.06202.paper_summary_zh: 在生產高帶寬超級集群上部署混合專家（MoE）模型，如NVIDIA的NVL72/576和華為的CloudMatrix384，帶來了超越原始互連帶寬的關鍵挑戰。雖然這些系統提供統一的全局地址空間和高帶寬的結構，但其在稀疏MoE通信方面的全部潛力受到三個基本瓶頸的阻礙：（1）由粗粒度的批量同步並行（BSP）協調的相互依賴通信階段施加的嚴格執行序列化；（2）隨著高互連帶寬無法擴展的禁止性同步開銷；以及（3）由於不考慮距離的非規則令牌流量調度而導致的嚴重負載不平衡。為了消除這些瓶頸，我們引入了UBEP（統一總線專家並行性），這是一個為現代超級集群架構重新思考MoE的全對全原語的生產就緒通信庫。通過大規模實驗，UBEP將全對全延遲降低了最多52.4%，並將MoE每輸出令牌推理時間（TPOT）降低了最多11.1%。
